ex_lb: Wa mäi Papp rosen ass, leet en d'Stier a Falen.
ex_en: When my dad is angry, he frowns.

ex_lb: Hien huet mech mam Ielebou an d'Säit gestouss.
ex_en: He elbowed me in the side.

ex_lb: Ech hunn eng Arthritt am rietsen Handgelenk.
ex_en: I have arthritis in my right wrist.

ex_lb: Schlo den Nol mam Hummer an d'Briet!
ex_en: Hammer the nail into the board!

ex_lb: Ech hunn e staarke Baart.
ex_en: I have a thick beard.

ex_lb: Meng Fra krut hire Brëll beim Optiker gefléckt.
ex_en: My wife had her glasses repaired at the optician's.

ex_lb: Déi Box ass mir ze kuerz.
ex_en: These trousers are too short for me.

ex_lb: Meng Frëndin huet d'Hoer nees laang.
ex_en: My girlfriend has long hair again.

ex_lb: Géi wäsch deng knaschteg Fangeren!
ex_en: Go and wash your dirty fingers!

ex_lb: Proppert Drénkwaasser ass fir de Mënsch liewensnoutwendeg.
ex_en: Clean drinking water is vital for humans.

ex_lb: Ech ginn owes midd.
ex_en: I get tired in the evening.

ex_lb: Déi eppes un, soss erkaals de dech!
ex_en: Put something on, or you'll catch a cold!

ex_lb: Nom ville Reen huet d'Wieder sech gebessert.
ex_en: After all the rain the weather has improved.

ex_lb: Ech kennen dee Mann vu Gesinn.
ex_en: I know that man by sight.

ex_lb: Héiers de mech?
ex_en: Can you hear me?

ex_lb: D'Fra spiert, wann d'Kand sech am Bauch beweegt.
ex_en: The woman feels when the baby moves in her belly.

ex_lb: Mir hunn den Auto missen drécken, fir en unzekréien.
ex_en: We had to push the car to get it started.

ex_lb: Am Sall war d'Loft esou dréchen, datt ech net konnt ophale mat houschten.
ex_en: The air in the room was so dry that I couldn't stop coughing.

ex_lb: Ech halen net op mat néitsen, ech mengen, ech hunn eng Allergie!
ex_en: I can't stop sneezing, I think I have an allergy!

ex_lb: Ech hu mer Gewiichter kaaft, fir doheem ze trainéieren.
ex_en: I bought myself weights to train at home.

ex_lb: Am Turne stellen d'Kanner sech der Gréisst no op.
ex_en: In PE the children line up by height.

ex_lb: Sport hëlleft, jonk ze bleiwen.
ex_en: Sport helps to stay young.

ex_lb: D'Mamm ëmäerbelt de Jong, ier en an den Zuch klëmmt.
ex_en: The mother hugs her son before he gets on the train.

ex_lb: Ier et schlofe gaangen ass, huet d'Kand der Tatta eng Bees ginn.
ex_en: Before going to bed, the child gave its aunt a kiss.

ex_lb: Denk net un deng Suergen, haut gëtt gefeiert!
ex_en: Don't think about your worries, today we celebrate!

ex_lb: Et muss ee vill Gedold hunn, wann ee mat Jugendleche schafft.
ex_en: You need a lot of patience when you work with young people.

ex_lb: Verléier net de Courage, et kommen nees besser Zäiten!
ex_en: Don't lose heart, better times will come again!

ex_lb: No mengem Mëssel war ech rout vu Schimmt.
ex_en: After my blunder I was red with shame.

ex_lb: Kee Problem, gär geschitt.
ex_en: No problem, you're welcome.

ex_lb: Maach et gutt, bis geschwënn!
ex_en: Take care, see you soon!

ex_lb: Gudde Mëtteg zesummen!
ex_en: Good afternoon everyone!

ex_lb: Ech hunn eise Konveniat a gudder Erënnerung behalen.
ex_en: I have fond memories of our class reunion.

ex_lb: Ech kafen e Cadeau fir d'Mamm.
ex_en: I buy a gift for mom.

ex_lb: Wann ech mäi Schnapp lass sinn, da gi mer zesumme schwammen.
ex_en: When I've got rid of my cold, we'll go swimming together.

ex_lb: Bleif gesond!
ex_en: Stay healthy!

ex_lb: Am Wanter gi vill Leit krank.
ex_en: In winter many people fall ill.

ex_lb: Du solls dech ausrouen.
ex_en: You should rest.

ex_lb: Ech sinn houfreg op dech.
ex_en: I am proud of you.

ex_lb: Hal op mat deene freche Bemierkungen!
ex_en: Stop those cheeky remarks!

ex_lb: Ech hu léiwer Lieder ewéi Daim.
ex_en: I prefer songs to poems.

ex_lb: Ier ech an d'Gebai eragelooss gouf, ass meng Identitéit iwwerpréift ginn.
ex_en: Before I was let into the building, my identity was checked.

ex_lb: D'Kanner gi séier erwuessen.
ex_en: The children grow up fast.

ex_lb: Mir ginn all al.
ex_en: We all grow old.

ex_lb: Déi Jugendlech kenne sech haut gutt mat den neien Technologien aus.
ex_en: Today's young people know their way around new technology.

ex_lb: D'Gemeng offréiert Turnstonne fir Senioren.
ex_en: The municipality offers exercise classes for senior citizens.

ex_lb: No der Begréissung huet de Minister eng Ried gehalen.
ex_en: After the welcome the minister gave a speech.

ex_lb: Du hues mäi Vertraue verluer.
ex_en: You've lost my trust.

ex_lb: All Respekt fir deng Leeschtung am Concours!
ex_en: Hats off to your performance in the competition!

ex_lb: Et ass wichteg, héiflech ze sinn.
ex_en: It is important to be polite.

ex_lb: Déi ganz Famill ësst zesummen.
ex_en: The whole family eats together.

ex_lb: Si ass haut gutt gelaunt.
ex_en: She is in a good mood today.

ex_lb: De Chef ass schlecht gelaunt.
ex_en: The boss is in a bad mood.

ex_lb: Hien huet bal ëmmer gutt Laun!
ex_en: He's almost always in a good mood!

ex_lb: Sengem Charme ka kee widderstoen.
ex_en: Nobody can resist his charm.

ex_lb: Jonk an al feieren zesummen.
ex_en: Young and old celebrate together.

ex_lb: Mir feieren hire Gebuertsdag.
ex_en: We celebrate her birthday.

ex_lb: Mir mussen den Dokter uruffen.
ex_en: We have to call the doctor.

ex_lb: Hie muss an d'Spidol goen.
ex_en: He has to go to hospital.

ex_lb: Du solls däi Medikament huelen.
ex_en: You should take your medicine.

ex_lb: Hatt ass e wichtegt Familljemember.
ex_en: She is an important family member.

ex_lb: Deen Tyrann hëlt dem Vollek all Fräiheeten.
ex_en: That tyrant takes away all the people's freedoms.

ex_lb: Ech fille mech wuel hei.
ex_en: I feel well here.
